subject: Hybrid Ward Representation Recommendation
overview: The subcommittee finalized its list of pros and cons regarding ward representation and voted to recommend a hybrid council model to the full Committee of the Whole. The group also prepared data presentations on demographics and election history for the next stage of the charter study.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the previous meeting.

items.title: Review of Pros and Cons for Ward Representation
items.summary: The subcommittee edited and refined a list of validated pros and cons for a hybrid representation system, addressing points on diversity, council efficiency, candidate accessibility, and neighborhood communication.

items.title: Recommendation on Council Model
items.summary: The subcommittee conducted a straw poll regarding the preferred model for city council representation. The subcommittee moved to recommend a hybrid ward representation model to the full committee, with one member remaining undecided.

items.title: Presentation Planning
items.summary: Members assigned roles for an upcoming presentation to the Committee of the Whole, including segments on demographic analysis and historical election data.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: A member of the public asked about the potential salary levels and budgetary impact of adding additional councilors to the city government.
